label: POST-PILOT TRAINING-DURATION VALIDATION; exploratory FIT/CAL
question: Do the short-schedule rankings persist under the standard240epoch recipe across3paired seeds?
rationale: 40epoch schedule decays at25/32/36, not a prefix of240epoch150/180/210. A low-LR tail plateau does not establish convergence under the standard recipe.
DKD warmup20 occupies50pct of short run but8.33pct of long run; effective training regimes differ.
Pilot has1seed, mixed GPU models, and small DKD gaps; the .1pp resource cutoff is not a statistical exclusion test.
Observed short curves do not show a uniquely strong late VCS rise. Long validation addresses uncertainty, not a prediction of a reversal.
selection_policy: Existing pilot-selected lambdas fixed for every method; no long-run lambda grid, no winning-seed or winning-anchor selection.

hardware.rule: All8runs sharing a seed use the same GPU model. Across-seed hardware differs as explicitly registered. Driver and environment still recorded.

primary: Fixed epoch240 CAL top1; per-seed VCS differences versus each matched control and anchor, then mean and SD across all3seeds.
secondary: Best CAL checkpoint by unchanged selection rule
Teacher-correct/anchor-wrong transfer at selected checkpoints via existing summary
interpretation: Report all endpoints. Keep the original practical gain criterion: mean final240 gain >=.2pp and >=2/3positive seeds against anchor and each matched auxiliary, with compatible last10epoch direction. This is descriptive, not a significance claim. If still inferior after240epochs, lower priority for this specific recipe, not the general theory.
stopping: All24runs planned regardless of interim ranking; abort only technical nonfinite/mismatched identity/storage/time failures. No automatic longer extension and no blind retries.
monitor: Reuse versioned existing other_apps controller; no extra permanent CPU job.
registration_scope: Current dense48matched full training continues. Microbenchmark does not prove full-training utility. A longer registration protocol should use its completed trajectories/costs; no arbitrary duplicate registration expansion here.
retrieval_scope: Current40epoch retrieval recipe is already the established full schedule; finish the three arms and NCR first.
limitations: All are CAL development results, no TEST access.
Short-pilot lambdas may not be optimal for240epochs; conclusion is conditional on these frozen choices.
New long seeds differ from the short seed; short-vs-long does not isolate duration from seed or schedule.
Three seeds do not justify treating a small difference as a proven advantage.
_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
